outcome_sought: Her held wages released now, a copy of the closure letter, the reason for closure, and proper notice if the account is being closed.
rationale: CRM says a 60-day notice letter went out on 1 Aug with closure on 30 Sep, but core banking has no letter event, restricted the account on 24 Sep before that notice would have ended, and shows a closure date of 24 Nov. CP-4.2 requires the pack to set out both versions and their sources without deciding which is right. Her 26 Sep call already disputed the decision and should have been treated as a complaint (CP-1.1). She cannot reach her wages and is borrowing to eat, so CP-5.3 points to putting the held funds right quickly.
